intent:
Write a ~420-word grounded buying recommendation for the NovaMax Pro over-ear headphones, drawing on the product listing on the One Stop Market (__SHOPPING__), at least one Postmill owner thread (__REDDIT__), and one English Wikipedia technical reference (__WIKIPEDIA__). The report MUST present BOTH concrete strengths (sound, battery, comfort) AND at least one concrete weakness (price, pad heat, clamp, repairability) for the NovaMax Pro, then end with a bounded recommendation naming who should and should not buy it. Cite every factual claim as a markdown [label](url) link to sandbox-local pages you actually opened. Answer starts with the report in Markdown; no chain-of-thought.

[Modality demonstrator: declares the read-only quantitative sql_query surface (SELECT-only over the Magento catalog + Postmill tables, allow-listed and row-capped). The reward is modality-agnostic; computed rows are landed keyed to the source PDP/forum page URL so a cite resolves identically to a fetch.]
